subject: Vendor activation: documentation & purchase-path decision
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor activation: documentation & purchase-path decision

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps on paperwork / commercial path so we can get a test environment spun up by the end of the month.

Summary from our call:
- Acme Health is leaning toward a PO-based purchase (finance prefers PO + Net30).
- Regulatory note: you asked about Data Residency and audit logs — we'll surface SOC2 report if needed during vendor setup.
- Immediate items needed from Acme to complete vendor activation: completed vendor intake packet, W-9 (or W-8 for non-US entity), and banking details for ACH.

What I attached: vendor-activation-packet.pdf (fillable packet), and redwood-w9-request.txt (instructions on how we accept tax docs).

Options for payment path (choose one):
1) PO via invoice (preferred by Acme finance) — Redwood Issues monthly invoice, Net30.
2) Corporate card (one-off purchases) — faster but may require cardholder and limits.
3) Cloud Marketplace (if you want consolidated billing via marketplace) — requires marketplace enrollment and may add procurement steps.

Can you confirm: 1) preferred payment path (PO/card/marketplace), 2) point of contact in AP for sending the packet, and 3) whether Acme requires a DocuSign packet?

If useful, I can schedule a 20–30 minute sync with our finance/ops (Ben) to walk through the vendor portal and expected fields.

Thanks — I'll put together a short checklist for AP once you confirm the path.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: vendor-activation-packet.pdf (16 pages, fillable), redwood-w9-request.txt (instructions)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 14:20:35 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: documentation & purchase-path decision

Thanks Jonas — great summary. Acme confirms the following: 

- Preferred payment path: PO via invoice (Net30). This is what our AP team wants.
- AP contact for the packet: Maria Gomez (maria.gomez@acmehealth.com). She handles vendor onboarding.
- DocuSign: yes, AP prefers a signed packet for contracts under $100k; please send the DocuSign link where applicable.

We will provide W-9 and banking details. Maria may ask for additional fields from the fillable packet (tax ID verification, vendor classification). Also worth noting: procurement sometimes requires a copy of the SOC2 Type II; can you confirm availability?

Happy to run a quick 15-minute call with Maria and your ops person tomorrow afternoon if that helps.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Health
samantha.lee@acmehealth.com

Subject: Re: Vendor activation: documentation & purchase-path decision

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirmation, Samantha.

Action items on our side (I'll own these and loop Ben for finance):
- I will send a DocuSign envelope for the vendor packet by EOD (if you prefer Maria to sign).
- Ben will confirm which bank account fields we need for ACH (we typically request routing + account + account type + remittance address).
- I'll attach SOC2 Type II summary and a link to our security page in the DocuSign cover note.

Maria — would tomorrow at 2pm PT for a 15-minute vendor onboarding sync work? If not, suggest two windows and we'll accommodate.

Next steps for Acme:
- Maria completes the vendor-activation-packet.pdf and uploads W-9 + banking details to the DocuSign envelope or Vendor Portal.
- Once we receive the completed packet, Redwood Ops will trigger vendor enrollment and issue first invoice for the test account.

I copied a short checklist below you can forward to Maria.

Vendor onboarding checklist for AP (short):
- Fillable vendor-activation-packet.pdf (company details, tax ID, contact)
- W-9 (or W-8 if applicable)
- Banking details (routing, account, account type)
- Preferred remittance email/address
- PO number (if Acme issues now)

I'll send the DocuSign link in a separate note.

Thanks,
Jonas

Hi Samantha / Jonas — Ben from Finance here. Quick notes and next steps from AP side: 

1) We can accept vendor enrollment either via DocuSign (signed packet) or via a vendor portal invite. If Acme prefers portal enrollment, use this invite link: https://portal.acmehealth.com/vendor/enroll/INVITE-98765 (we'll coordinate SSO fields if needed).
2) Required fields for ACH (please confirm): company legal name, EIN, routing number, account number, account type (checking/savings), remittance email.
3) SOC2 Type II: Jonas will attach the summary in the DocuSign cover note; if your security team needs the full report we can start an NDA + secure share.

Maria or Procurement team — when you send the completed packet, please CC finance@redwoodinference.com so invoices route correctly.

If a 15-minute walkthrough still helps, I can join. Jonas — I’m free tomorrow 2pm PT.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
